messages:
Nadia: quick ask — need ephemeral log-proxy role injected into my pod to pull a small sample of prod telemetry to scrub PII. saw a few user names in the eval sample, want to redact before wider eval run.
Riley: can you confirm exact s3 prefix + why log-proxy instead of a presigned URL? presigned urls are preferred for tiny one-offs.
Nadia: prefix s3://redwood-telemetry/prod/model-eval/2026-03-15/part-0001.gz. need log-proxy because it strips request headers and applies our redaction rules (proxy enforces tenant isolation). we don’t have a presign route into the proxy right now. only need read-only, ~5MB.
Jordan: link the ticket pls so we have an audit trail (and retention note).
Nadia: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4123 — ticket has the offending sample + scrub checklist.
Riley: ok paste the minimal IAM policy you need and the exact time window.
Nadia: minimal policy snippet (read-only, scoped):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-telemetry/prod/model-eval/*"]
    }
  ]
}
```
Window: 30 minutes starting 2026-03-16T16:00:00Z. will run in the canary namespace and only pull the single object.
sec-bot: Created ephemeral role request ENG-4123-ephemeral-1765432109, pending approval from @Riley.
Riley: approve with conditions: 1) run in namespace `canary` only, 2) any extracted data must be uploaded to `s3://redwood-secure-scrubbed/ENG-4123/` and encrypted, 3) add scrub steps to the ticket and attach the scrubbed object checksum. after that i'll flip the grant. :white_check_mark:
Nadia: understood — will run in canary and post upload link to the ticket when done. thx.
ops-oncall: i'll watch the canary cluster during the window, ping me when you start. :eyes:
sec-bot: Role injected into pod `nadia-eval-runner-6` (namespace: canary). Expires in 30 minutes.
Nadia: pulled sample, ran scrub, uploaded to s3://redwood-secure-scrubbed/ENG-4123/part-0001-scrubbed.gz — added checksum + scrub checklist to the ticket.
Nadia: removed any extracted artifacts from the pod and cleared temp files.
Riley: spot-checked the scrubbed object metadata and a few lines — no PII visible. revoking role now. :lock:
sec-bot: Role ENG-4123-ephemeral-1765432109 revoked.
Nadia: thanks all :heart:
